title: ARTS, PARKS, LIBRARIES, AND COMMUNITY ENRICHMENT and HOUSING COMMITTEES' REPORTS relative to expanding access to pet-inclusive housing and reducing…
text:
[Council File 26-0528]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ARTS, PARKS, LIBRARIES, AND COMMUNITY ENRICHMENT and HOUSING COMMITTEES' REPORTS relative to expanding access to pet-inclusive housing and reducing housing-driven pet relinquishment. A. ARTS, PARKS, LIBRARIES, AND COMMUNITY ENRICHMENT COMMITTEE REPORT
Recommendations for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Hernandez - Blumenfield, Jurado):
1. INSTRUCT the Los Angeles Housing Department (LAHD), in consultation with the Department of Animal Services (DAS), City Attorney, Chief Legislative Analyst (CLA), and the City Administrative Officer (CAO), to report to Council within 90 days with an assessment of existing City pet housing policies, including policies around permissible security deposits and non-refundable fees, and findings previously adopted or prepared by the County of Los Angeles (County) and the Board of Animal Services Commissioners; best practices and recommendations to expand access to pet inclusive housing and reduce housing-driven pet relinquishment across all housing units; and, an analysis of potential impacts on housing stability, animal shelter intake, and the associated fiscal impacts and projected budget savings to the City.
2. REQUEST the City Attorney, in consultation with the LAHD, DAS, and CLA, to report to Council with recommendations for a new Ordinance, informed by existing state law, City authority, and identified practices, that would reduce or remove breed, weight and size restrictions for pets in housing that is not publicly funded and provide additional protections as deemed feasible in the LAHD's assessment.
B. HOUSING COMMITTEE REPORT Recommendations for Council action, as initiated by Motion (Hernandez - Blumenfield, Jurado):
1. CONCUR with the June 23, 2026, Arts, Parks, Libraries, and Community Enrichment Committee recommendations.
2. INSTRUCT LAHD to conduct stakeholder engagement with tenants, rental housing providers and other affected parties including an exploration of insurance, liability and operational impacts.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the CAO nor the CLA has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
(Arts, Parks, and City Facilities Committee has waived consideration of this matter.)
summary: Council motion on pet housing policies and landlord restrictions on pets.
